messages:
mike: Deploy window for saffron-7b-v1 tomorrow 2026-03-25 00:30 UTC. Plan: staged enable in model-catalog. Proposed fallback ordering: saffron-7b-v1 -> iridium-13b-v2 -> baseline-3b. Need QA ack and release notes finalized. tagging @rachel @anjali @deploy-bot
rachel: Looks fine. Release notes draft ready — I'll add quantization caveats and measured fallback latencies. Pushing to docs repo in a minute.
anjali: Ops checklist: reserve 4 warm slots per region, set pin TTL=2h during ramp, rollback threshold: 3% error spike OR 40% increase in p50 latency vs baseline.
ben: Can we add an auto-drain gate? Last time a noisy signal messed up the first hour. Suggest: if error_rate>2% for 10m, reduce traffic to fallback.
mike: Agree. @deploy-bot can you add that gate to the rollout config?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled enable saffron-7b-v1 at 2026-03-25T00:30:00Z. Gates configured: metrics-check, observability-ack. Auto-fallback order set: [saffron-7b-v1, iridium-13b-v2, baseline-3b]. Rollback triggers set: error_rate>3% for 5m OR p50_latency>1500ms for 3m. Additional mitigation: gradual drain on threshold breach.
rachel: Note: baseline-3b uses a slightly different tokenizer. Add a line to release notes about prompt-tuning recommendations when fallback hits baseline.
anjali: Ops runbook snippets — commands to use during rollout: `deploybot abort $thread`, `deploybot pin saffron-7b-v1 --ttl=2h`, telemetry query for quick error-rate check: `sum(rate(errors[5m]))/sum(rate(requests[5m]))`. Keep these at the top of the runbook.
sam: QA ask: can we run a micro-canary first in NA-west only? 1% traffic for 15m, then 10% for 30m before widening.
mike: Yes. Change window 00:30-02:30 UTC. If metrics look good, plan to scale to 100% by 03:30 UTC.
ben: Clarify ownership: who has final authority to rollback? Ops oncall + product PM for go/no-go?
anjali: I'll be oncall for the window. Ops will execute rollback; PM signs off if it's safe to continue.
rachel: I'll be online during the window as PM. Release notes (DRAFT): https://docs.internal/release/saffron-7b-v1-draft — please review and flag anything blocking.
mike: Last check before lock: telemetry alert thresholds confirmed? @deploy-bot show-config
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: current rollout config -> canary: NA-west 1% -> 10%; metrics thresholds: error_rate_threshold=0.03, latency_p50_threshold_ms=1500; fallback order as above; observability hooks: trace-sampling=100% for canary, log-level=debug for model-runtime.
sam: QA ACK for micro-canary. Will run prompt-sample suite during the 15m window.
rachel: :thumbsup: docs updated with prompt guidance and fallback notes.
mike: Locking change window and start times. If anything degrades beyond configured gates, abort, pin legacy model and escalate. Thanks all.
